question: In September 2025, which region was declared as India’s first cold desert biosphere reserve under the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spiti Valley**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve**, centered around the **Spiti Valley** in **Himachal Pradesh**, was recognized under the **UNESCO** programme in **September 2025** to enhance global conservation of high-altitude ecosystems.
 
• This biosphere reserve spans across a vast area of approximately **7,770 square kilometers** within the **Lahaul and Spiti** district, representing the **Trans-Himalayan** biogeographic zone.
 
• The core area of this reserve includes the **Pin Valley National Park**, while the buffer and transition zones encompass the **Kibber Wildlife Sanctuary**, **Sarchu**, and **Chandertal**.
 
• The primary objective of the **UNESCO** designation is to protect the unique **biodiversity** of the region, specifically focusing on the **Snow Leopard**, which is the flagship species of the area.
